mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_attribution (user_id, first_src, first_cmp, first_ref, first_start, first_at, reg_src, reg_cmp, reg_ref, reg_start, reg_seen_at, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{firstSrc}, #{firstCmp}, #{firstRef}, #{firstStart}, #{firstAt}, #{regSrc}, #{regCmp}, #{regRef}, #{regStart}, #{regSeenAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, first_src, first_cmp, first_ref, first_start, first_at, reg_src, reg_cmp, reg_ref, reg_start, reg_seen_at, created_at FROM account_attribution WHERE user_id = #{userId}
